Research floor: near-deep-researcher equivalent run across Hot Dinners (opening announcement, address, opening-week menu), The Infatuation (discovery listing, acknowledges not yet reviewed in depth), London On The Inside and JULIAXEATS (both on the original Clapton site, menu/pricing detail carried over as the same concept). Reddit: searched r/london and site:reddit.com via web search; genuinely no thread exists yet for a venue this new (7 weeks old at Angel) — floor met as 'checked, none found,' not a blocked leg. Google reviews: read live via claude-in-chrome (Google Maps blocks nothing here, no escalation needed) — 3.7 stars/42 reviews, three most-recent reviews read directly and quoted/paraphrased in-body (tamago sando praise, 'drinks on the smaller side' critique), reported honestly rather than rounded up. Instagram (@uchibake, 15.6K followers, both Angel and Hackney locations run from one account) read directly for events (none) and images (two photos selected, see heroImage and in-body image notes). Five preferred-source-equivalent consultations: Hot Dinners, The Infatuation, London On The Inside, JULIAXEATS, Instagram — five sources beyond Google/Reddit, per the floor.

Coordinator sign-off pass (near-tov-police/language-tic-police/near-legal-counsel/chief-editor lenses): opening avoids bare-name and banned-formula openers; no crowd-consensus framing; no internal-discourse leakage (no mention of Near's tiers/rotation/coverage gaps in body copy); honest on the 3.7-star rating rather than cherry-picking only positive reviews; age-neutral framing throughout. Legal: the 'drinks on the smaller side' Google review critique is a fair, sourced, non-defamatory quality note, not a business-threatening allegation, and is attributed to 'a recent Google reviewer' per platform-attribution convention; no real-person likeness issues (no staff named); Instagram image use follows the same implied-consent basis this skill extends to a venue's own official channels, no identifiable faces. Structural rules: two paragraph breaks added to keep every paragraph under 100 words; two sub-headers at density (feeds 466-word body, floor is ceil(466/250)=2 images — hero plus one in-body drinks-counter image meets the floor exactly). Link-density: five in-text external links (Hot Dinners x2, London On The Inside, JULIAXEATS, Google Maps) plus one internal NearLink (Borough Market) — passes. Price signal: JULIAXEATS's itemized Clapton pricing (£3.20-£6.50) carried into body as the best available current price data (menu is shared across both sites); no Angel-specific price sheet found, disclosed as such rather than invented. Red team: no price stated as more current than sourced; no internal jargon; queue/Saturday framing reads reader-facing, matches operator's brief (weekday mornings easy, Saturday line 'keeps moving', explicitly avoiding a stunt-queue narrative). Discover audit: hero fails the ~16:9 aspect spec (portrait Instagram capture, see heroImage licenseNote) — logged as an open finding, not blocking publish, same category as a prior TOAD Bakery gap; headline/shortTitle do not over-promise past the body.
